statement: Derive the weak form of the 1D transient heat equation on 0 < x < L. Multiply the equation by a test function w(x), integrate over (0, L), and integrate the conduction term by parts once, so that no second derivative of T remains. Do not assume that w vanishes at x = 0 or x = L. Move every term to one side so that the weak form reads R = 0, and return R.
